put.description: Updates an integration setting in MailFloss.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: Setting type to modify. MailFloss documents whitelist, blacklist, aggressiveness, frequency, or action.

data.keyword.description: Keyword used for blacklist or whitelist insertion.

data.processed.description: Whether the job has finished processing.

data.localpart.description: Use the localpart for blacklist or whitelist insertion.

data.domain.description: Use the domain for blacklist or whitelist insertion.

data.email.description: Use the whole email address for blacklist or whitelist insertion.

data.match.description: Match type. MailFloss documents exact or contains.

status.description: Success status for the integration setting change.
